newsitem.title: USA: MGE wheat closes lower on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: MGE wheat closes lower on technical selling.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower on technical selling, traders said.

"The technicals are negative to this market after the last two days. We tried to make new highs and rejected them two days in a row. There is good support at around $4.00 to $4.01 a bushel, basis May," one trader said.
But the May contract broke through that support near the close and ended 6-1/4 cents down at $3.98-3/4.
Traders said a fund-related drop in CBOT wheat futures also hit prices.
Atwood-Peavey sold two million bushels of May and Benson Quinn sold one million bushels of July, traders said.
Barley futures remained quiet and were untraded.
May barley was unchanged at $6.61 per cwt.
